title: What's New: Troubleshooting Business Central Agents

chapters.title: Accessing agent logs and task details

features.name: Agent decision-making framework
features.description: Agents make decisions based on instructions, available tools, virtual user interface representation, task messages, and step history. All these elements combine to determine what tool to call and how to interact with Business Central.

features.name: Agent task logging and view log entries
features.description: The agents tasks page provides access to task logs showing all steps an agent has performed, including assistance requests with detailed messages about why the agent needs help.

features.name: Agent view details page
features.description: Provides detailed insight into agent decision-making with information about what the agent saw, what tools it had access to, what data it memorized, what messages it had access to, page stack, and settings.

features.name: What the agent saw section
features.description: Shows a textual view of what the agent perceives in Business Central including page information, page type, editability, page descriptions, actions, and available fields that the agent can interact with.

features.name: What tools the agent had access to
features.description: Shows what capabilities and tools the agent could use at a specific point in time, helping users understand and design agent instructions based on available capabilities.

features.name: What data the agent memorized section
features.description: Allows users to see what data the agent retained in its memory for use later in the process, helping diagnose whether the agent captured the right information for decision-making.

features.name: What messages the agent had access to section
features.description: Shows all messages the agent could see up to a specific point, allowing users to understand what information the agent was working with when making decisions.

features.name: Page stack fact box
features.description: Shows which pages were open at a specific point, tracking the agent's navigation between pages as it opens and closes them to accomplish its task.

features.name: Agent settings and formatting
features.description: Provides information about settings such as currency used and formatting that the agent applies to its messages, helping diagnose output-related issues.

quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the foundational concept that agents use multiple inputs to decide their actions rather than operating on single criteria.

quotes.text: The first of them is the instructions which is the blueprint how the agent works and what its purpose is
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that instructions are the core component defining agent behavior and goals.

quotes.text: the agent is telling me it can't proceed with the task because there is a risk field that is it is supposed to fill
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates a real troubleshooting scenario showing how agents request assistance when they cannot find expected fields.

quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that the view details feature is the key tool for diagnosing agent issues by exposing the decision-making process.

quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates that tool visibility is crucial for understanding what actions an agent can perform and for designing instructions.
